component.name: Iris
component.summary: A light, fast browser with shields built in

description.p: Iris is a small browser written in Go. Most pages are drawn by WebKitGTK and video, social sites and web apps by Electron (Chromium), and Iris adds what keeps browsing light and private.

ul.li: Iris Shields: ads, trackers, cookie notices and fingerprinting blocked
Containers for separate sign-ins, private tabs and split view
Background tabs that sleep and unload to save memory
One light Liquid Glass look, sharp at every display scale
Every search answered by Google AI Mode from high-quality, current sources
Sync with Iris for Android over your own network, with no servers
